title: Childcare for Informal-Sector Workers: Delivery Models, Access, and Welfare
title_primary: Childcare for Informal-Sector Workers: Delivery Models, Access, and Welfare
authors: Arinaitwe, Jacklyn Makaaru, Bogere, George, Fiore, Anna, Herskowitz, Sylvan, Lang, Megan 等
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-09-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Childcare burdens limit productivity among women in the informal sector, but little is known about the optimal design of childcare support. The study randomizes 883 women market vendors in Kampala, Uganda to receive free workplace- or community-based childcare. Free childcare redistributes caregiving away from household members, raises women’s hourly earnings, and improves child development and women’s well-being. Community centers achieve higher utilization and larger gains in development and well-being, while workplace centers generate larger economic impacts. Both models have a high marginal value of public funds. Community centers currently dominate, but workplace-based centers could prove superior if operated at scale.

title: Unconditional Cash Transfers: A Bayesian Meta-Analysis of Randomized Evaluations in Low and Middle Income Countries

abstract: We use Bayesian meta-analysis methods to estimate the impact of unconditional cash transfers (UCTs).Aggregating evidence from 115 studies of 72 UCT programs in middle and low income countries, we find strong and positive average treatment effects on ten of thirteen outcomes: monthly household total and food consumption, monthly income, labor supply, school enrollment, food security, psychological well-being, total assets, financial assets, and children height-for-age.We examine seven specific theoretical and policy hypotheses, such as presence of savings frictions, dynamic effects, curvature of marginal returns, targeting effects, "nudge" effects, labor supply elasticity and related "dependency" theories, and contextual heterogeneity.
abstract_zh: 我们采用贝叶斯元分析方法来评估无条件现金转移（UCTs）的影响。汇总来自中低收入国家72个UCT项目的115项研究证据，我们发现，在十三个结果指标中，有十个显示出强烈且正面的平均处理效应：月度家庭总消费与食品消费、月度收入、劳动力供给、学校入学率、食品安全、心理健康、总资产、金融资产以及儿童身高年龄比。我们考察了七个具体的理论与政策假设，包括储蓄摩擦的存在、动态效应、边际收益的曲率、目标定位效应、“助推”效应、劳动力供给弹性及相关“依赖”理论，以及情境异质性。

title: A Century of Farm Household Income Estimation and Comparison
title_zh: 一个世纪的农户收入估算与比较
title_primary: 一个世纪的农户收入估算与比较
title_secondary: A Century of Farm Household Income Estimation and Comparison
authors: Paul Wilson, Paul Caskie
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Understanding farm household (FHH) income has been a central concern of agricultural economists and policymakers for more than a century. This review traces the evolution of concepts, definitions, data sources, analytical approaches and empirical evidence used to estimate and compare FHH incomes. It argues that the central measurement challenge is the distinction between the farm business and the FHH. Farm business income is often observable, but household economic welfare depends on total income, income composition, household structure, wealth, liquidity and exposure to volatility. The evidence does not support a simple conclusion that FHHs are universally income‐disadvantaged. In many developed‐country contexts, average income differences narrow or disappear once household size and composition, in‐kind benefits and the choice of comparison group are taken into account. However, income variability, low‐income incidence, distributional outcomes and asset‐rich but cash‐constrained households remain important policy concerns. The review highlights the limits of farm accountancy data for evaluating income‐support objectives and argues for stronger household‐level and linked administrative data systems. Improved measurement is essential for credible policy targeting, transparent evaluation and analysis of FHH well‐being, resilience, generational renewal and social sustainability.
abstract_zh: 理解农户家庭收入一直是农业经济学家和政策制定者一个多世纪以来的核心关注点。本综述追溯了用于估算和比较农户家庭收入的概念、定义、数据来源、分析方法及实证证据的演变过程。文章认为，测量的核心挑战在于区分农业经营实体与农户家庭。农业经营收入通常可观测，但家庭经济福利取决于总收入、收入构成、家庭结构、财富、流动性及面对波动的暴露程度。证据并不支持农户家庭普遍处于收入劣势的简单结论。在许多发达国家情境下，一旦考虑家庭规模和构成、实物福利及比较组的选择，平均收入差距便会缩小或消失。然而，收入波动性、低收入发生率、分配结果以及资产充裕但现金受限的家庭仍是重要的政策关切。本综述强调了农场会计数据在评估收入支持目标方面的局限性，并主张建立更强有力的家庭层面及关联行政数据系统。改进测量对于可信的政策瞄准、透明的评估以及分析农户家庭福祉、韧性、代际更新和社会可持续性至关重要。

authors: Xing Ling, Qian Wu, Kun Chen
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Rolling-window methods are widely used to explore time variation in economic relationships. Testing across overlapping windows induces a multiple-testing problem and can inflate the familywise error. Existing corrections are often either overly conservative or computationally intensive. We propose a harmonic mean p -value procedure that provides a global test together with window-level diagnostics. We establish iterated rejection-tail calibration of the global test and weak familywise error control for the associated diagnostic rule under overlap-induced dependence. Simulations using several standard time-series tests show accurate size, higher power, and substantially lower computational cost than bootstrap-based extreme-statistic procedures.
abstract_zh: 滚动窗口方法被广泛用于探索经济关系中的时间变化。跨重叠窗口进行检验会引发多重检验问题，并可能夸大族系误差。现有修正方法往往要么过于保守，要么计算成本高昂。我们提出了一种调和平均p值程序，该程序提供全局检验及窗口级诊断。我们确立了全局检验的迭代拒绝尾部校准，并在重叠诱导依赖下建立了相关诊断规则的弱族系误差控制。使用若干标准时间序列检验的模拟显示，该方法具有准确的检验规模、更高的功效，且计算成本远低于基于自助法的极值统计量程序。

title: What Work Does Generative AI Do?
title_zh: 生成式人工智能做什么工作？
title_primary: 生成式人工智能做什么工作？
title_secondary: What Work Does Generative AI Do?
authors: Alexander Bick, Adam Blandin, David J. Deming, Tyler R. Schumacher
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We measure how workers use genAI for their jobs in a nationally representative survey linking genAI adoption to detailed occupations and tasks. Our data provide the first task-level genAI adoption indexes, which we show can inform analyses of genAI’s labor market impact. Exposure scores explain some, but far from all, of the variation in adoption across occupations and tasks. We also distinguish our indexes from measures based on genAI platform chat logs, which differ conceptually and tend to over-classify chats into generic activities spanning many occupations. Finally, we highlight that current adoption is widespread but shallow: genAI is used across many occupations and tasks, yet within most of them, fewer than half of workers adopt. This indicates substantial variation among workers doing very similar work, suggesting that understanding who adopts may matter as much as understanding which tasks genAI assists.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项全国代表性调查，衡量了工人在工作中如何使用生成式人工智能（genAI），并将genAI的采用与详细的职业和任务联系起来。我们的数据提供了首个任务层面的genAI采用指数，并证明这些指数能为分析genAI对劳动力市场的影响提供信息。暴露度评分解释了职业和任务间采用差异的一部分，但远非全部。我们还将我们的指数与基于genAI平台聊天记录的度量区分开来，后者在概念上有所不同，且倾向于将聊天过度归类为跨越众多职业的通用活动。最后，我们强调当前的采用虽广泛但浅层：genAI在许多职业和任务中均有使用，但在大多数情况下，采用者不足半数工人。这表明从事非常相似工作的工人之间存在显著差异，提示理解谁在采用genAI可能与理解genAI辅助哪些任务同等重要。

authors: Drishan Banerjee, Galina Hale, Harrison Shieh
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Post-pandemic inflation raised fears that U.S. monetary tightening would trigger a repeat of the 1982 sudden stop in capital flows to emerging economies. Yet as of 2026 no global recession has followed. We establish three stylized facts distinguishing the 1980s from the 2020s, beyond the shift to flexible exchange rates: monetary policy effectiveness, fiscal space, and external vulnerabilities. We rationalize them in a Mundell-Fleming framework with a fiscal space constraint, which predicts a central role for fiscal space in transmitting foreign currency risk-free rate increases. Cross-country evidence confirms that fiscal space shapes economic performance post-tightening.
abstract_zh: 疫情后的通货膨胀引发了人们的担忧，即美国货币紧缩将重演1982年新兴经济体资本流入的突然停止。然而，截至2026年，全球并未出现衰退。我们确立了三个典型事实，用以区分1980年代与2020年代，除了转向浮动汇率制度之外：货币政策有效性、财政空间和外部脆弱性。我们在一个包含财政空间约束的蒙代尔-弗莱明框架中对其进行了合理化解释，该框架预测财政空间在传导外币无风险利率上升中扮演核心角色。跨国证据证实，财政空间塑造了紧缩后的经济表现。

title: Linking educational loan subsidies to pay-as-you-go pension reforms
title_zh: 教育贷款补贴与现收现付养老金改革的联动研究
title_primary: 教育贷款补贴与现收现付养老金改革的联动研究
title_secondary: Linking educational loan subsidies to pay-as-you-go pension reforms
authors: Kazui Sumizawa
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines public pension reform in a small open economy model where households fully finance education. Departing from previous studies that assume fully publicly funded education, we introduce loan interest subsidies on education in the presence of intergenerational transmission of human capital, which enables an earlier phase-out of pay as-you-go (PAYG) pensions in a Pareto-improving way. We extend the analysis to a closed economy where wages and interest rates are endogenously determined. By incorporating general equilibrium effects through factor prices, we show that loan interest subsidies make a Pareto-improving, gradual reduction of PAYG pensions feasible even in closed economies. This result highlights the efficiency gains from linking pension reform with educational loan support, in contrast to prior studies that overlook private education spending or factor price adjustments.
abstract_zh: 本研究在一个家庭完全承担教育融资的小型开放经济模型中考察公共养老金改革。与以往假设教育完全由公共资金资助的研究不同，我们在人力资本代际传递的背景下引入教育贷款利息补贴，从而能够以帕累托改进的方式更早地逐步取消现收现付（PAYG）养老金。我们将分析扩展至工资和利率内生决定的封闭经济。通过纳入要素价格的一般均衡效应，我们表明，即使在封闭经济中，教育贷款利息补贴也能使帕累托改进的、渐进式削减PAYG养老金成为可行。这一结果凸显了将养老金改革与教育贷款支持相联系的效率收益，与先前忽视私人教育支出或要素价格调整的研究形成对比。

title: Preemptive Policies and Risk-Off Shocks in Emerging Markets
title_zh: 新兴市场中的先发制人政策与风险规避冲击
title_primary: 新兴市场中的先发制人政策与风险规避冲击
title_secondary: Preemptive Policies and Risk-Off Shocks in Emerging Markets
authors: Mitali Das, Gita Gopinath, Sebnem Kalemli-Ozcan
official: 官方在线 2022-01-14 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We show that “preemptive” capital flow management measures (CFM) can reduce emerging markets and developing countries’ (EMDE) external finance premia during risk-off shocks, especially for vulnerable countries. Using a panel dataset of 56 EMDEs during 1996-2020 at monthly frequency, we document that countries with preemptive policies in place during the five year window before risk-off shocks experienced relatively lower external finance premia and exchange rate volatility during the shock compared to countries which did not have such pre-emptive policies in place. We use the episodes of Taper Tantrum and COVID-19 as risk-off shocks. Our identification relies on a difference-in-differences methodology with country fixed effects where preemptive policies are ex-ante by construction and cannot be put in place as a response to the shock ex-post. We control the effects of other policies, such as monetary policy, foreign exchange interventions (FXI), easing of inflow CFMs and tightening of outflow CFMs that are used in response to the risk-off shocks. By reducing the impact of risk-oﬀ shocks on countries’ funding costs and exchange rate volatility, preemptive policies enable countries’ continued access to international capital markets during troubled times.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，“预防性”资本流动管理措施（CFM）能够在风险规避冲击期间降低新兴市场和发展中经济体（EMDE）的外部融资溢价，尤其是对脆弱国家而言。利用1996年至2020年间56个EMDE的月度面板数据，我们记录到，在风险规避冲击前五年窗口期内已实施预防性政策的国家，在冲击期间经历了相对较低的外部融资溢价和汇率波动性，相比之下，未实施此类预防性政策的国家则不然。我们以“缩减恐慌”和COVID-19事件作为风险规避冲击的案例。我们的识别策略依赖于一种包含国家固定效应的双重差分方法，其中预防性政策在构造上即为事前设定，无法在事后作为对冲击的应对措施而实施。我们控制了其他政策的影响，如货币政策、外汇干预（FXI）、放宽流入性CFM及收紧流出性CFM等，这些政策均是对风险规避冲击的应对措施。通过减轻风险规避冲击对国家融资成本和汇率波动性的影响，预防性政策使各国在动荡时期仍能持续进入国际资本市场。

authors: Jan-Philip R Uhlemann, Alfons Oude Lansink, James J Leahy, Jean-Paul Chavas, Tobias Dalhaus
official: 官方在线 2026-08-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: There are optimistic targets for phosphorus recycling from waste streams to solve environmental and supply issues simultaneously. The recycling process requires high energy inputs, thus the joint distribution of (input) energy and (output) fertilizer commodity prices is a crucial determinant of the profitability of investing. We propose a methodology to model the investment risk and price dependencies using quantile vector autoregression and copulas. Moreover, we show that standard approaches overestimate the variance of investment returns. Finally, we find that phosphorus recycling investments are only profitable with substantial subsidies or savings on disposal expenditures.
abstract_zh: 针对从废物流中回收磷以同时解决环境与供应问题的乐观目标，回收过程需要高能量投入，因此（投入）能源与（产出）肥料商品价格的联合分布是投资盈利性的关键决定因素。我们提出了一种方法，利用分位数向量自回归和连接函数来建模投资风险与价格依赖性。此外，我们表明标准方法高估了投资回报的方差。最后，我们发现磷回收投资仅在获得大量补贴或节省处置支出时才具有盈利性。

abstract: We estimate short-run electricity demand responses to price changes for Norwegian households from 2023 to 2025, using continental solar and wind forecasts, and hydrological inflow to instrument supply-driven price variation. The presence of several instruments for the price changes allows us to explicitly test the margins at which substitution happens. Households’ electricity substitution is real but coarse: households mostly choose between day and night consumption with a price elasticity of 0.073. Substitution across hours within these blocks, or across days, is more limited.
abstract_zh: 我们利用大陆太阳能和风能预测以及水文流入作为供给驱动价格变动的工具变量，估算了2023年至2025年挪威家庭对电价变化的短期电力需求响应。由于存在多个价格变动工具，我们能够明确检验替代发生的边际。家庭的电力替代是实际存在但较为粗略的：家庭主要在日间和夜间消费之间进行选择，价格弹性为0.073。在这些时段内或跨日的小时间替代则更为有限。

title: The Impact of Cross‐Border Personnel Mobility Facilitation on Corporate Innovation Quality: A Study Based on the Visa‐Free Transit Policy

authors: Yin Dehong, Zhang Chengji
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Visa‐Free Transit Policy is a major opening‐up initiative launched by China to eliminate barriers to cross‐border personnel mobility and build an interconnected cross‐border network. Using a sample of China's A‐share listed firms from 2006 to 2019, this paper adopts the Difference‐in‐Differences (DID) model to empirically examine whether the policy can effectively improve the innovation quality of firms in visa‐free transit cities. The results show that the policy significantly improves local firms' innovation quality. It can function via two mediating mechanisms: promoting corporate supply chain diversification and facilitating inter‐firm collaborative innovation. Heterogeneity analysis shows that its innovation‐boosting effect is stronger for three groups of firms: firms in regions with strong intellectual property protection, those in transportation hubs and small and medium‐sized enterprises (SMEs). In addition, the 144‐h visa‐free transit policy also exerts a significant positive effect on corporate innovation quality. However, the limited observation period and confounding effects of prior policies impede the accurate estimation of the policy's net effect.
abstract_zh: 免签过境政策是中国为消除跨境人员流动障碍、构建互联互通跨境网络而推出的重大开放举措。本文以2006年至2019年中国A股上市公司为样本，采用双重差分（DID）模型实证检验该政策能否有效提升免签过境城市企业的创新质量。研究结果表明，该政策显著提升了当地企业的创新质量。其作用机制主要有两条中介路径：促进企业供应链多元化以及推动企业间协同创新。异质性分析显示，该政策对三类企业的创新促进效应更为显著：知识产权保护力度较强地区的企业、交通枢纽城市的企业以及中小企业（SMEs）。此外，144小时免签过境政策对企业创新质量同样具有显著的正向影响。然而，有限的观测期及先前政策的混杂效应制约了对该政策净效应的精确估计。

title: Merger Control in a Changing World
title_zh: 变革世界中的并购控制
title_primary: 变革世界中的并购控制
title_secondary: Merger Control in a Changing World
authors: Volker Nocke, Martin Peitz, Nicolas Schutz
official: 官方在线 2026-06-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How should merger control account for future changes in market conditions? We study horizontal merger policy in the presence of industry-wide cost or demand shocks, using both a homogeneous-goods Cournot model and a multiproduct-firm model of price competition with constant elasticity of substitution (CES) or multinomial logit (MNL) demand. We derive two main sets of results. First, regarding deterministic shocks: under both Cournot competition with incomplete pass-through and multiproduct-firm price competition, an adverse shock increases industry concentration but calls for softer merger control. Second, regarding cost or demand uncertainty: under a cautious maxmin approach, aggregate cost uncertainty calls for softer merger control under the same assumptions. By contrast, under a risk-neutral expected-consumer-surplus standard, greater cost uncertainty demands tougher merger control in the Cournot model with log-concave demand, and in the multiproduct-firm price competition model when the outside option is sufficiently attractive.
abstract_zh: 并购控制应如何考虑市场条件的未来变化？我们研究了在行业范围成本或需求冲击下横向并购政策，采用了同质商品古诺模型以及具有恒定替代弹性（CES）或多项逻辑（MNL）需求的多产品企业价格竞争模型。我们得出两组主要结果。首先，关于确定性冲击：在古诺竞争不完全传导和多产品企业价格竞争两种情况下，不利冲击提高了行业集中度，但要求更宽松的并购控制。其次，关于成本或需求不确定性：在谨慎的最大最小方法下，同样的假设条件下，总体成本不确定性要求更宽松的并购控制。相反，在风险中性的预期消费者剩余标准下，更大的成本不确定性在古诺模型（需求对数凹）以及外部选项足够吸引人的多产品企业价格竞争模型中，要求更严格的并购控制。

abstract: This paper examines the gender differences in labor market integration among refugees and their determinants. It focuses on a longitudinal dataset that covers the entire refugee population in Switzerland over 20 years. During the period examined, the majority of refugees came from low-income economies in Africa and Asia. The quasi-random allocation of asylum seekers across Swiss cantons, which differ in their socio-economic characteristics, provides a natural experiment to identify the effects of source country culture and the role of local initial conditions in shaping refugees’ labor-market integration trajectories. Our empirical findings show that women refugees from countries with more conservative gender norms (measured by female-to-male labor force participation ratios and fertility rates) have less favorable labor market outcomes, with these effects varying in their persistence over time. The analysis further reveals the negative role of initial unemployment and the positive role of co-ethnic networks in the cantons of arrival, with these effects varying by gender and network characteristics. Finally, local attitudes toward gender equality reduce the gender gap in labor market outcomes among refugees.

abstract: Firms in decentralized markets often trade using quantity contracts, agreements specifying quantity prior to the point of sale. These contracts are valuable because they provide quantity assurance, as trading frictions could prevent a buyer and seller from matching in the spot market. abstract: How does district magnitude affect the quality of political representation? The Condorcet Jury Theorem (CJT) predicts that majority decisions improve with group size when members vote independently and are more likely than not to be correct. We test whether this aggregation mechanism applies to political decisions by examining whether larger legislative delegations better reflect constituent preferences. Nominal district magnitude often overstates the number of independent decision-makers because of party discipline. We therefore introduce effective district magnitude as a measure that more accurately captures the number of independently voting politicians within a constituency. Using 263 Swiss referenda (1992–2024) matched to parliamentary decisions, we find that the probability that a majority of a district’s delegation aligns with the preferences of its constituents increases with (effective) district magnitude, consistent with the CJT. The CJT aggregation mechanism closely predicts delegation-constituency congruence only for effective, not nominal, district magnitude. Our results provide empirical evidence that the CJT applies to representative democracies. They also show how party discipline limits the advantages of larger districts.
abstract_zh: 摘要 选区规模如何影响政治代表质量？孔多塞陪审团定理（CJT）预测，当成员独立投票且正确概率超过一半时，多数决策质量随群体规模提升。本文通过考察较大立法代表团是否更能反映选民偏好，检验这一聚合机制是否适用于政治决策。由于政党纪律约束，名义选区规模往往高估独立决策者数量。为此，我们引入有效选区规模这一指标，更精确地衡量选区内独立投票的政治家数量。基于1992-2024年263项瑞士公投与议会决策的匹配数据，我们发现选区代表团多数意见与选民偏好一致的概率随（有效）选区规模增加而上升，这与CJT预测相符。CJT聚合机制仅对有效选区规模（而非名义选区规模）能精准预测代表团与选民的契合度。本研究为CJT适用于代议制民主提供了实证证据，同时揭示了政党纪律如何限制大选区优势。

abstract: Attitudes to inequality differ across countries and contexts, and understanding these differences is important for the design of redistributive policies. We here present evidence on fairness preferences in Kenya, based on a series of lab experiments with participants from Nairobi's largest informal settlement and its main university. This innovative sample allows us to compare the attitudes and beliefs of two important groups in society: the poor and the educated. We find that while the participants from the informal settlements are more egalitarian than the university students, they are less egalitarian than what is generally perceived. A second important finding is the sharp distinction made between distribution and redistribution, where participants are far more willing to equalize funds with no clear ownership compared to funds where there is an ex-ante allocation. Finally, many participants view luck as a more deserving source of inequality than performance, an observation that is contrary to what is commonly found in the literature. Our results highlight the complexity of people's fairness views and show the importance of not relying on stereotypes when designing redistributive policies that harmonize with local norms.
abstract_zh: 不同国家与情境下，人们对不平等的态度各异，理解这些差异对于设计再分配政策至关重要。本文基于在内罗毕最大非正规居住区及其主要大学参与者中进行的一系列实验室实验，提供了关于肯尼亚公平偏好的证据。这一创新样本使我们能够比较社会中两个重要群体——贫困群体与受过教育群体——的态度与信念。我们发现，尽管非正规居住区的参与者比大学生更倾向于平等主义，但他们的平等主义程度低于普遍认知。第二个重要发现是，在分配与再分配之间存在显著区分，参与者更愿意均等化无明确所有权的资金，而对于存在事前分配的资金则意愿较低。最后，许多参与者认为运气比表现更应成为不平等的来源，这一观察与文献中常见结论相悖。我们的结果凸显了人们公平观念的复杂性，并表明在设计符合当地规范的再分配政策时，不应依赖刻板印象的重要性。

abstract: This paper develops a calibrated general-equilibrium model to study how different configurations of trade and financial policy reshape the hierarchy of global currencies—and the U.S. dollar's position at its anchor. Currency safety and anchor status arise endogenously from each economy's 'effective size'—the weight its domestic shocks carry in setting world prices. Tariffs reduce this effective size on the goods side; capital controls do the same on the financial side. A unifying result emerges: The economy that maintains the deepest integration with the global trading network retains the largest safety premium and gains anchor status. We use this framework to evaluate the effects of three policy levers for Europe that affect the effective size of the euro: internal harmonization and enlargement, trade openness, and capital-account openness. The stakes are large: In our model, shifts in currencies' safety can redirect global capital flows and alter sovereign borrowing costs by hundreds of billions of dollars annually.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个校准的一般均衡模型，用以研究贸易与金融政策的不同配置如何重塑全球货币的层级结构——以及美元在其中的锚定地位。货币的安全性与锚定地位内生于各经济体的“有效规模”——即其国内冲击在设定世界价格时所承载的权重。关税会降低商品侧的有效规模；资本管制则在金融侧产生相同效果。一个统一的结论由此显现：与全球贸易网络保持最深度融合的经济体，将保留最大的安全溢价并赢得锚定地位。我们运用这一框架评估了影响欧元有效规模的三种欧洲政策杠杆的效果：内部协调与扩张、贸易开放度以及资本账户开放度。其影响极为重大：在我们的模型中，货币安全性的变动能够重新引导全球资本流动，并每年改变主权借贷成本高达数千亿美元。

abstract: This paper investigates the role of central bank verbal communication in China’s foreign exchange market, focusing on the coordination channel through which communication influences exchange rate dynamics and market expectations. We develop a heterogeneous agent model where fundamentalists’ confidence depends on exchange rate misalignment and central bank communication. The model indicates that verbal communication can strengthen market coordination and accelerate the exchange rate’s reversion towards its fundamental value. Empirically, we construct a novel index related to central bank verbal communication based on official statements and examine its effects using a Smooth Transition Regression GARCH (STR-GARCH) model. Our results show that PBOC verbal communication is associated with changes in exchange rate dynamics and volatility, consistent with the coordination mechanism. We conduct a series of robustness checks and address potential endogeneity concerns arising from the central bank’s reaction to market conditions. This study contributes to the literature on foreign exchange intervention and expectation management by providing new evidence on the role of verbal communication in a managed exchange rate regime.

abstract: Benefit overpayments are a common byproduct of benefit programs and often lead to substantial debts among individuals. Although effective repayment and debt-relief policies are a key policy concern, empirical evidence on their impact is still scarce. In this study, we investigate the impact of welfare debt relief on labor market and mental health outcomes among financially vulnerable individuals. We exploit an eligibility cutoff applied by a Dutch welfare office to identify causal effects, using an instrumented difference-in-difference and fuzzy regression discontinuity design. Using linked administrative data, our findings suggest that debt relief reduces the use of mental health medication by about 1.1 percentage points (13.9%), consistent with lower financial stress. We find no significant effects on employment, earnings, and welfare receipt for the full sample. However, employment increases among debtors with ex-ante severe debt positions. This indicates the initial presence of debt overhang problems with larger debts.

abstract: Fish consumers are often challenged by tradeoffs between nutritional benefits and contaminant risks, which increase due to environmental pollution. Health campaigns and labeling initiatives can guide decision-making by providing information both on contaminant risk and nutritional value of a product, but it is not well understood how consumers react to such complex dual labels. We use data from a stated choice experiment in Kenya’s Lake Victoria region to study how consumers respond to dual labels on fish products, and how their responses to each label interact. We focus on the tradeoff between polyunsaturated fatty acids and contamination with microcystins, a class of toxins produced by harmful algae blooms that can accumulate in fish tissue. Our findings suggest that, faced with a dual information policy, consumers react rationally to dual health attribute labeling, and that nutrient labels and contaminant warnings can function concurrently, indeed even be mutually reinforcing, but pose a risk of inadvertently concentrating unhealthful consumption in less responsive subpopulations.

abstract: Women around the world face a heavier care burden than men, restricting their participation in the labor force. At the same time, the shortage of quality, accessible, and affordable care services undermines human development and well-being. Limited investment in early childhood care and education reduces children’s learning and future earnings potential. Similarly, inadequate elderly care undermines health, independence, and well-being among older adults. Investing in care is, therefore, important not only for closing gender gaps but also for boosting human capital outcomes. It also makes a compelling economic case for investment, given the care economy’s potential to drive growth and create jobs in the context of ongoing demographic shifts. This note discusses how public works programs (PWPs) may reduce care burden, increase the provision of care services for those in need, and build skills for the care economy. Drawing on examples of World Bank-supported PWPs that provide childcare, the note explores how such programs can be designed and implemented, and what potential benefits and challenges early evidence reveals.

title: Do re‐employment bonuses increase employment? Evidence from the Idaho Return to Work Bonus programme

authors: Duncan R. Hobbs, Michael R. Strain
official: 官方在线 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In June 2020, Idaho announced the Return to Work Bonus (RWB) programme, which provided residents who returned to work with bonuses of up to $1500. We present difference-in-differences, triple differences, event studies and synthetic control estimates suggesting that the programme may have supported employment and workforce participation following its enactment. For example, from difference-in-differences estimates, we find that the employment–population ratio rose by 3.6 percentage points, the unemployment rate fell by 0.7 percentage points, and the non-participation rate fell by 2.9 percentage points in Idaho relative to other states following the introduction of the RWB programme. If these results from Idaho were to generalize to the economy as a whole, then they would not be enough to arrest a moderate recession, but they would meaningfully accelerate labour market recovery. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first paper to study the effects of re-employment bonuses on the US labour market outside an experimental setting.

abstract: Allowing risk preferences to depend on the correlation between lottery outcomes can explain behavioral anomalies, while empirical evidence is limited and mixed. abstract: The Common Correlated Effects (CCE) approach enjoys considerable popularity for estimating factor-augmented panel data models. A key benefit is that by orthogonalizing the data on the available cross-section averages, the unobserved components are eliminated from the data, regardless of their order(s) of integration. This obviates the need for such knowledge, and makes CCE particularly attractive for macroeconomic applications, where the set of unobservables might contain both stationary and non-stationary variables. Despite of these benefits, it is often neglected that the pooled CCE (CCEP) estimator suffers from an asymptotic bias in TN−1→τ>0 panels, which too is common in macroeconomic research. This bias is highly disruptive for inference but cannot generally be remedied with analytical corrections. As such, we establish in this paper the validity of the cross-section bootstrap under general unknown factors for TN−1→τ<∞ as (N,T)→∞. We show that the scheme replicates the distribution of the CCE estimators, leading to a straightforward bias-correction, and confidence intervals that enable asymptotically valid inference for τ<∞. This significantly broadens the applicability of the CCEP method. We in addition explore the case where idiosyncratics serve as another source of non-stationarity. Simulation experiments show that our theoretical predictions translate well to finite samples, and that the methodology outperforms alternative bias-corrections and estimators. The method is finally demonstrated with a gravity trade application based on the dataset of Serlenga and Shin (2007).
abstract_zh: 公共相关效应（CCE）方法在估计因子增强面板数据模型时广受欢迎。其关键优势在于，通过利用可获得的截面平均值对数据进行正交化处理，未观测成分得以从数据中消除，无论其积分阶数如何。这免除了对此类知识的依赖，使得CCE特别适用于宏观经济应用，其中不可观测变量集合可能同时包含平稳与非平稳变量。尽管有这些优点，但常常被忽视的是，在TN−1→τ>0的面板中，合并CCE（CCEP）估计量存在渐近偏差，而这种情况在宏观经济研究中同样普遍。该偏差对推断造成严重干扰，且通常无法通过解析修正加以解决。因此，本文在一般未知因子条件下，针对TN−1→τ<∞且(N,T)→∞的情形，确立了截面自助法的有效性。我们证明该方法能够复制CCE估计量的分布，从而提供直接的偏差修正及置信区间，使得在τ<∞时能够进行渐近有效的推断。这显著拓宽了CCEP方法的适用范围。此外，我们还探讨了个体特异项作为非平稳性另一来源的情形。模拟实验表明，我们的理论预测在有限样本中表现良好，且该方法优于其他偏差修正方法和估计量。最后，我们基于Serlenga和Shin（2007）的数据集，通过引力贸易应用对方法进行了实证演示。

abstract: The corporate labour share reflects the proportion of labour income in the primary distribution of national income. Leveraging a quasi-natural experiment from the reform of social insurance contribution collection, this paper employs a difference-in-differences model. It uses panel data on listed firms from 2015 to 2022. The findings indicate that the reform improved the corporate labour share by enhancing compliance and solidifying the contribution base. The effects are more pronounced in firms with weak external oversight, strong internal oversight, small size, and private ownership. Similar patterns are observed in regions with high labour mobility or less generous pension systems. The analysis also reveals evidence of labour substitution among low-skilled workers, particularly in low-end manufacturing. This paper provides valuable policy insights into strengthening the income distribution function and promoting the sustainable development of the social insurance system.
abstract_zh: 企业劳动收入份额反映了劳动报酬在国民收入初次分配中的占比。在全球劳动收入份额下降的背景下，中国社会保险制度改革对劳动收入份额的影响日益受到关注。本文利用社会保险缴费征收改革的准自然实验，采用双重差分模型，基于2015至2022年上市公司面板数据，研究发现该改革通过提高缴费遵从度和夯实缴费基数，提升了企业劳动收入份额。这一效应在外部监督较弱、内部监督较强、规模较小及民营企业中更为显著；在劳动力流动性高或养老金制度保障水平较低的地区，也呈现出类似模式。分析还揭示了低技能劳动力，尤其是低端制造业中的劳动替代现象。本文为强化收入分配功能、促进社会保险制度可持续发展提供了有价值的政策启示。

title: Mitigating the impact of extreme heat: spatial diversification and corporate investment
title_zh: 缓解极端高温影响：空间多元化与企业投资
title_primary: 缓解极端高温影响：空间多元化与企业投资
title_secondary: Mitigating the impact of extreme heat: spatial diversification and corporate investment
authors: Zhuoyang Lyu, Tie Shi
official: 官方在线 2025-09-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We link records of firm investment to granular measures of extreme heat exposure for China’s listed companies from 2003 to 2019. We find that, for every ten additional days per year with days above 90°F, the investment rate decreases by an average of 0.2% points. Furthermore, our findings suggest that extremely high temperatures lead to increased volatility in corporate operating income. Companies tend to reduce long-term debt and increase cash holdings to cope with the increased uncertainty. Notably, corporate investments with tighter financing constraints are more negatively impacted by extremely high temperatures. Heterogeneity analysis revealed that the impact is primarily concentrated among small and private enterprises, as well as enterprises with limited access to credit resources and those with more graphically concentrated subsidiaries.
abstract_zh: 我们将企业投资记录与中国上市公司2003年至2019年间极端高温暴露的精细度量数据相连接。研究发现，每年气温超过90华氏度的天数每增加十天，投资率平均下降0.2个百分点。此外，我们的结果表明，极端高温导致企业营业收入的波动性增大。为应对不确定性上升，企业倾向于减少长期债务并增加现金持有。值得注意的是，融资约束更紧的企业投资受极端高温的负面影响更为显著。异质性分析显示，这一影响主要集中在小型和私营企业，以及信贷资源获取受限和子公司地理分布更为集中的企业。

title: Testing the Marshall-Lerner condition in Korea: do asymmetric price adjustments matter?
title_zh: 检验韩国马歇尔-勒纳条件：非对称价格调整是否重要？
title_primary: 检验韩国马歇尔-勒纳条件：非对称价格调整是否重要？
title_secondary: Testing the Marshall-Lerner condition in Korea: do asymmetric price adjustments matter?
authors: Jungho Baek, Min-Joon Kim
official: 官方在线 2025-09-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Marshall-Lerner (ML) condition posits that currency depreciation enhances the trade balance if the sum of the absolute values of export and import price elasticities exceeds one. This study investigates the applicability of the ML condition to Korea’s commodity trade. Employing both the linear autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) and nonlinear ARDL (NARDL) models, we examine 14 export and 14 import commodities from January 2000 to October 2023. The results indicate that the ML condition is not satisfied for any commodity under symmetric price assumptions. However, when asymmetric price adjustments are considered, the ML condition holds when relative export and import prices decline for four commodities, including computers and electronic equipment, the largest export and import category, and transport equipment, the third-largest export category. Collectively, these commodities account for 37.1% of total export value and 21.8% of total import value. These findings emphasize the significant role of price asymmetries in determining the validity of the ML condition for Korea’s trade.
abstract_zh: 马歇尔-勒纳条件认为，若进出口价格弹性的绝对值之和大于1，则货币贬值将改善贸易收支。本研究考察了马歇尔-勒纳条件对韩国商品贸易的适用性。通过采用线性自回归分布滞后模型和非线性自回归分布滞后模型，我们分析了2000年1月至2023年10月期间14种出口商品和14种进口商品的数据。结果表明，在对称价格假设下，没有任何商品满足马歇尔-勒纳条件。然而，当考虑非对称价格调整时，对于包括计算机与电子设备（最大进出口类别）以及运输设备（第三大出口类别）在内的四种商品，在相对进出口价格下降的情况下，马歇尔-勒纳条件成立。这些商品合计占出口总值的37.1%和进口总值的21.8%。这些发现强调了价格非对称性在决定韩国贸易中马歇尔-勒纳条件有效性方面的重要作用。

title: Efficiency and adequacy of public health resources in achieving maternal health outcomes: the case of India
title_zh: 印度公共卫生资源在实现孕产妇健康结果中的效率与充足性
title_primary: 印度公共卫生资源在实现孕产妇健康结果中的效率与充足性
title_secondary: Efficiency and adequacy of public health resources in achieving maternal health outcomes: the case of India
authors: Pinak Sarkar Nutan Shashi Tigga a Economics & Public Policy, Lal Bahadur Shastri Institute of Management, New Delhi, Indiab Jindal School of Banking and Finance, O P Jindal Global University, Sonipat, India
official: 官方在线 2025-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examined the efficiency of the health system in improving maternal health outcomes, i.e. increasing institutional delivery (desirable output) and reducing the maternal mortality ratio (undesirable output). We used a nonradial, nonoriented Slack-based measure data envelopment analysis model to assess the efficiency of the health system across 19 states of India between 2016 and 2020. The overall average efficiency score suggested potential for a 30% improvement in the health system efficiency in India, with only six states emerging as efficient. Interestingly, few states that were endowed with more than adequate health resources were inefficient. We find that resource constraint states such as Bihar and Jharkhand have emerged as efficient. To substantiate the use of undesirable adjusted model instead of the transformed model, we used the Wilcoxon ranked-signed test to estimate the statistical significance. We conclude that incorporating undesirable outputs while measuring efficiency is imperative. Our findings suggest that states that are inefficient with excess capacity should prioritize the efficient utilization of resources. Additionally, adequate resources should be allocated to resource constraints and efficient states such that they achieve better health outcomes. Furthermore, the diversification of health resources across levels of care could be a suggestive measure for some states.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了卫生系统在改善孕产妇健康结果方面的效率，即提高机构分娩率（期望产出）并降低孕产妇死亡率（非期望产出）。我们采用非径向、非导向的松弛变量测度数据包络分析模型，对2016年至2020年间印度19个邦的卫生系统效率进行了评估。总体平均效率得分表明，印度卫生系统效率存在30%的提升空间，仅有六个邦表现出高效。有趣的是，少数拥有充足以上卫生资源的邦却效率低下。我们发现，如比哈尔邦和贾坎德邦等资源受限的邦反而表现出高效。为验证采用非期望调整模型而非转换模型的合理性，我们运用了威尔科克森符号秩检验来评估统计显著性。我们得出结论，在衡量效率时纳入非期望产出至关重要。我们的研究结果表明，产能过剩且效率低下的邦应优先考虑资源的有效利用。此外，应向资源受限且高效的邦分配充足资源，以便其实现更好的健康结果。同时，对于某些邦而言，卫生资源在不同护理层级间的多元化配置可能是一项建议性措施。

title: Private equity for pension plans? Evaluating private equity performance from an investor’s perspective
title_zh: 养老金计划的私募股权投资？从投资者视角评估私募股权绩效
title_primary: 养老金计划的私募股权投资？从投资者视角评估私募股权绩效
title_secondary: Private equity for pension plans? Evaluating private equity performance from an investor’s perspective
authors: Arthur G. Korteweg, Stavros Panageas, Anand Systla
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2024-11-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We evaluate private equity (PE) performance using investor-specific stochastic discount factors, and examine whether investors could benefit from changing their allocation to PE.Plans invest in PE funds with higher average risk-adjusted performance.This is mainly due to access to successful PE managers, not superior selection skill.Decomposing returns into risk-compensation and "alpha", we find that some plans obtain higher PE returns by taking more risk without earning higher, and in some cases earning lower, risk-adjusted returns, broadly consistent with agency problems within plans.
abstract_zh: 我们采用投资者特定的随机贴现因子评估私募股权（PE）业绩，并考察投资者是否能够通过调整PE配置获益。投资计划倾向于选择平均风险调整后业绩更高的PE基金，这主要得益于接触成功的PE管理人，而非卓越的筛选能力。通过将收益分解为风险补偿和“阿尔法”，我们发现部分投资计划通过承担更高风险获取更高PE收益，但并未获得更高（某些情况下甚至更低）的风险调整后收益，这与投资计划内部的代理问题基本一致。

title: A User’s guide for inference in models defined by moment inequalities
title_zh: 矩不等式定义模型中的推断用户指南
title_primary: 矩不等式定义模型中的推断用户指南
title_secondary: A User’s guide for inference in models defined by moment inequalities
authors: Ivan A. Canay, Gastón Illanes, Amilcar Velez
official: 官方在线 2023-11-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Models defined by moment inequalities have become a standard modeling framework for empirical economists, spreading over a wide range of fields within economics. From the point of view of an empirical researcher, the literature on inference in moment inequality models is large and complex, including multiple survey papers that document the non-standard features these models possess, the main novel concepts behind inference in these models, and the most recent developments that bring advances in accuracy and computational tractability. In this paper we present a guide to empirical practice intended to help applied researchers navigate all the decisions required to frame a model as a moment inequality model and then to construct confidence intervals for the parameters of interest. We divide our template into four main steps: (a) a behavioral decision model, (b) moving from the decision model to a moment inequality model, (c) choosing a test statistic and critical value, and (d) accounting for computational challenges. We split each of these steps into a discussion of the “how” and the “why”, and then illustrate how to take these steps to practice in an empirical application that studies identification of expected sunk costs of offering a product in a market.
abstract_zh: 由矩不等式定义的模型已成为实证经济学家的标准建模框架，广泛覆盖经济学内的多个领域。从实证研究者的角度来看，关于矩不等式模型推断的文献庞大且复杂，包括多篇综述文章，这些文章记录了这些模型所具有的非标准特征、这些模型推断背后的主要新颖概念，以及带来准确性和计算可行性进步的最新发展。本文提供了一份实证实践指南，旨在帮助应用研究者应对将模型构建为矩不等式模型并随后为感兴趣参数构建置信区间所需的所有决策。我们将模板分为四个主要步骤：（a）行为决策模型，（b）从决策模型过渡到矩不等式模型，（c）选择检验统计量和临界值，以及（d）考虑计算挑战。我们将每个步骤分解为“如何做”和“为何这样做”的讨论，然后通过一个实证应用来展示如何将这些步骤付诸实践，该应用研究识别在市场中提供产品的预期沉没成本。
